properties.locationNotes: On the south slope of the ridge immediately W of the motorway intersection W of Pradorrey.
properties.description: A series of small scale workings along the slope of the ridge to the W of the motorway intersection by Pradorrey. A channel comes from the W, and at least six small-scale ditches divert from it down the slope to the south. These look either like prospections, or were very small-scale mining operations. Probably the channel continued eastward to feed the mine at Pradorrey, but the intervening stretch has been destroyed by the motorway intersection.

properties.locationDataSource: Satellite imagery and site visit

properties.description: Small hydraulic mine working; a channel coming from the S bifurcates around an oval area in the centre of the working (resembling a corona, but the ditches are too shallow), and converge again in two exit ditches towards the stream. The eastern side is also fed by another ditch from the SE.
